description: The ring railway Sloterdijk – Lelylaan – Zuid – RAI: the streets under it and the decks over it (the named places are in named.json).

records.label: Carrascoplein under the Sloterdijk railway and its road deck
records.notes: Ortho: Station Sloterdijk's rail viaduct and its road deck over the Carrascoplein; panorama 02628 is under the deck (soffit, piers, shopfronts). Round 2 (2026-11-12): the BGT metro deck cluster runs 850 m along the Sloterdijk viaduct (52.3845-52.3922) and took in the Kimpoweg, where panorama recording_2025-07-01_09-03-48_02081 shows the tram at street level among the viaduct's columns (user report #13, kimpoweg-rails). The decks and zone are cut to the Carrascoplein (52.3870-52.3905); the Kimpoweg tram is out of the record, and the register no longer makes a span for a track whose bed lies nearer the street than the deck top.

records.label: Radarweg and Orlyplein decks over the railway at Sloterdijk
records.notes: Ortho: the Radarweg and Orlyplein road decks cross the station tracks west of Sloterdijk; panorama 02888 shows the station hall and the deck edge. Kind road-over-rail.

records.label: Dirk Deutekompad under the western ring railway
records.notes: Ortho: three rail decks over the Dirk Deutekompad and the water beside it; panoramas 000186 and 000390 are under the decks (piers, soffit, water).

records.label: Jan van Galenstraat under the western ring railway
records.notes: Ortho: three rail decks over the Jan van Galenstraat and its tram; panorama 00227 is under them (pier, soffit).

records.label: Jan Evertsenstraat under the western ring railway
records.notes: Ortho: two rail decks over the Jan Evertsenstraat; panorama 01826 is under them (piers, soffit, stair). The draft's third deck (4431-3) is a footbridge over the water and is left out.

records.label: Robert Fruinlaan under the western ring railway
records.notes: Ortho: three rail decks over the Robert Fruinlaan; panorama 00491 is under them (pier, soffit).

records.label: Hemsterhuisstraat under the western ring railway
records.notes: Ortho: three rail decks over the Hemsterhuisstraat; panorama 00981 is under them (painted abutments, soffit).

records.label: Cornelis Lelyplein / Cornelis Lelylaan under the western ring railway (Station Lelylaan)
records.notes: Ortho: Station Lelylaan on its rail viaduct over the Cornelis Lelylaan and the Lelyplein paths; panorama 00756 is in the station hall under the deck.

records.label: Plesmanlaan / Heemstedestraat under the western ring railway
records.notes: Ortho: two rail decks over the Plesmanlaan and the water north of it; panorama 00947 is under them by the water. The draft's low deck east of the tracks (4431-2045, top -0.37) is the Plesmanlaan's own bridge over the water and is left out.

records.label: Ringweg-West under the Ringweg-West slip deck (Nieuwe Meer junction)
records.notes: Ortho: the A10 slip deck curving over the Ringweg-West carriageway at the Nieuwe Meer junction; panorama 003535 is on the deck (parapet).

records.label: Parnassusweg under the A10 and the southern ring railway
records.notes: Ortho: the two A10 carriageway decks and the rail decks of Station Zuid over the Parnassusweg; panorama 00800 is under them at the tracks' foot.

records.label: Minervapassage under the A10 and the railway at Station Zuid
records.notes: BGT tunneldeel under the tracks and the A10 at Station Zuid (the Minervapassage); panorama 08104 is on the A10 above it. No portals listed: the passage opens into the station, so no dark mouth is drawn.

records.label: Beethovenstraat under the A10, the southern ring railway and the Noord-Zuidlijn
records.notes: Ortho: the A10 decks and the rail and Noord-Zuidlijn decks of Station Zuid over the Beethovenstraat; panoramas 00077 and 01538 are under them (piers, soffit).

records.label: Europaboulevard under the A10 and the southern ring railway (Station RAI)
records.notes: Ortho: the A10 decks and Station RAI's rail decks over the Europaboulevard; panorama 00091 is under them (round piers, soffit).
